description: Have the catalog's own model (Gemini) read an article through the article_playbook runbook and KEEP the reading in the signed-in reader's history, in one call. For a client with no model of its own (the Android analyser app), or when the reader asks for a Gemini reading. If you can read the article yourself, prefer emit_runbook_surface + save_reading. Pass `text` when you already have the article (it is then the only source the reading may quote), else `url` and it is fetched server-side. Takes 20-60 s. Needs a signed-in reader; capped per reader per day.

concerns.description: What the reader wants the reading to look for or push back on.

domains.description: For lens "apply": the reader's domains, comma-separated.

source_title.description: The article's headline, kept with the reading for attribution.

text.description: The article text, if the caller already fetched it. Truncated to 60000 chars.

url.description: The article's public URL. Required: it is the attribution link.

name: read_article

note.description: Set when the article text was truncated.

ok.description: True when the reading was produced.

reads_today.description: Reads used today by this reader.

save_warning.description: Why the reading was not saved.
